description: Na₈Mg(FeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.68 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.88 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.89 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.59 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.58 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.52 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.97 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.98 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-25°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-25°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom.
